title: UK Police Mock Criminal For Missing GTA6 Release
description: UK police in Derbyshire went viral on TikTok by mocking a high-speed chase suspect for missing out on the highly anticipated launch of GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## UK Police Troll High-Speed Chase Suspect Over Missing GTA 6

In an unexpected crossover between real-world law enforcement and gaming culture, police in Derbyshire, UK, have gone viral for a TikTok video mocking a criminal involved in a high-speed car chase. According to reports from IGN Games, the authorities hilariously pointed out that the suspect's poor life choices will result in them missing out on the highly-anticipated launch of GTA 6.

### The Real-World Consequences of Joyriding

While high-speed getaways and evading law enforcement are staple mechanics in the Grand Theft Auto franchise, attempting them in real life carries severe, legal consequences. The Derbyshire police department leaned into this pop culture parallel, using humor on social media to highlight the unfortunate reality awaiting the suspect. Instead of exploring the next evolution of open-world crime, the individual will be spending their time facing the legal repercussions of their actions.

### GTA 6's Cultural Footprint

The anticipation surrounding GTA 6 continues to dominate internet discourse, making it an easy reference point for viral content. The fact that law enforcement agencies are now using the game's release as a benchmark for missing out on major cultural moments speaks volumes about the title's massive global footprint. While the suspect's getaway attempt failed spectacularly, it has provided the internet with a memorable laugh ahead of the game's launch.

## Editor's Take

Using a major gaming launch to troll a reckless criminal is a brilliant PR move by the Derbyshire police. It highlights the power of internet culture while delivering a clear message about the dangers of street racing. Let this be a reminder: play your crimes safely in virtual Los Santos, not on real-world highways.
